source.title: AlphaCrafter: A Full-Stack Multi-Agent Framework for Cross-Sectional Quantitative Trading

summary: Just-published (May 2026) multi-agent LLM framework for autonomous cross-sectional quantitative trading. Formalizes the environment, defines agent policies, and presents an optimization objective for end-to-end alpha mining and portfolio construction. Potentially automates alpha factor discovery similar to what we do manually (H198, H202).

hypothesis_candidate.title: AlphaCrafter multi-agent LLM for cross-sectional stock selection
hypothesis_candidate.description: Replicate or adapt AlphaCrafter framework on our 30-stock (or 200-stock for H202-XL) universe. Use the multi-agent orchestration for automated factor discovery and portfolio construction. Compare OOS Sharpe to H198 (6-1m momentum, 1.174) and H202-C (XGBoost, 1.278).
prerequisites: stable-baselines3 or similar agent framework installed
hypothesis_candidate.priority: low — interesting but complex; do H205/H202-XL first
